source_rows.snippet:
script = Tcl_NewStringObj(
"	    ::apply [::list {{pattern *}} {\n"
"		::set cmds {}\n"
"		::foreach cmd [::info commands ::tcl::mathfunc::$pattern] {\n"
"		    ::lappend cmds [::namespace tail $cmd]\n"
"		}\n"
"		::foreach cmd [::info commands tcl::mathfunc::$pattern] {\n"
"		    ::set cmd [::namespace tail $cmd]\n"
"		    ::if {$cmd ni $cmds} {\n"
"			::lappend cmds $cmd\n"
"		    }\n"
"		}\n"
"		::return $cmds\n"
"	    } [::namespace current]] ", -1);
